subject: ScoutOps Embedded Devs Retreat — co-run workshop & post-event content
messages:
From: Mira Singh <mira@scoutops.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Cc: partnerships@scoutops.ai, tom@devhatch.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: ScoutOps Embedded Devs Retreat — co-run workshop & post-event content

Hi Ben / Laura —

Hope you're both well. Quick intro — I run partnerships at ScoutOps (we build an edge-first inference SDK used by device teams). We put on a small, invite-only event each fall for embedded & edge ML engineers and the vendors who support them. This year we want to run a joint event with Redwood: a two-day "Embedded Devs Retreat" focused on inference at the edge, hosted in San Francisco (small venue, 40-60 engineers).

High level idea:
- Day 1 (technical): deep-dive workshop "Embedding Inference at Scale" (hands-on labs + benchmarking session)
- Day 2 (customer + GTM): customer panel (migration story), 1-hour demo of ScoutOps + Redwood Dedicated integration, and a joint content shoot (short video + write-up)

We think Redwood is a natural co-host: your runtime + our SDK is a compelling story for edge & hybrid customers. Proposed dates: Sep 28-29 or Oct 5-6.

What we'd ask from Redwood:
- 1 senior engineer for the hands-on workshop (half day)
- 1 PM or CS speaker for the customer panel
- Commitment to a joint post-event blog and short video (co-branded)

Attached is a short proposal & draft agenda (ScoutOps-Retreat-Proposal.pdf). We can share a landing page draft and a rough budget if the concept looks interesting.

Would love to set a 30-min call next week to figure out scope & sponsorship (we can be flexible on budget if Redwood wants to own the workshop track).

Thanks,
Mira Singh
Head of Partnerships, ScoutOps
M: +1 415-555-0132
attachments: ScoutOps-Retreat-Proposal.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwoodai.com
To: Mira Singh <mira@scoutops.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScoutOps Embedded Devs Retreat — co-run workshop & post-event content

Thanks Mira — this looks promising. Quick answers and asks from our side: 

- Outcome goals: what's the primary objective you want from Redwood? Lead gen (MQLs), a handful of joint POCs, or press/brand? We'll prioritize differently based on that.
- Commitment: we can provide an engineer + PM for the agenda items you outlined, but need estimates for time (prep + on-site).
- Content: happy to do a joint blog and short video, and we can offer a Redwood podcast slot the week after the event for promotion.

Laura, Vivek, Jonas — looping you in to scope the field marketing and partnerships bits. Can you flag any immediate conflicts with early Oct?

Mira — can you share: expected attendee profile, sample invite list (if you have it), and a rough sponsorship ask (range)? That will help us decide whether this is a co-sponsor event or Redwood-led with ScoutOps as a supporting partner.

Happy to do a 30 min call next Tue (Aug 10) 10am PT.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
To: Mira Singh <mira@scoutops.ai>, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScoutOps Embedded Devs Retreat — co-run workshop & post-event content

On Thu, Aug 5, 2027 at 9:03 AM ben_carter@redwoodai.com wrote:
> Mira — can you share: expected attendee profile, sample invite list (if you have it), and a rough sponsorship ask (range)?

Thanks Ben / Mira —

Quick tactical notes from field marketing:
- Audience: if we're targeting 40-60 engineers, that's prime for technical acquisition. Please confirm seniority mix (ICs vs engineering managers) — that will change how we write the landing page.
- MQL definition: we use a 3-stage definition for events. Please confirm if ScoutOps will share attendee emails + company metadata post-event.
- Creative: we should own the landing page and form in HubSpot (we can do a co-branded template). I attached a quick ROI sketch (Redwood-ROI-estimates.xlsx) showing conversion benchmarks for similar co-hosted events.
- Promo window: recommend 6 weeks lead time for paid social + developer community outreach.

Action items I need from ScoutOps before we greenlight: attendee persona, sample invite list or ICP, and sponsorship tier (bronze / silver / gold with deliverables).

Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
attachments: Redwood-ROI-estimates.xlsx

From: Mira Singh <mira@scoutops.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwoodai.com, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Cc: partnerships@scoutops.ai, tom@devhatch.com
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScoutOps Embedded Devs Retreat — co-run workshop & post-event content

Thanks — this is great feedback. Short update & next steps: 

- Dates: we can lock Oct 5-6. Venue is confirmed (small tech studio in SF).
- Attendees: target 40-60 engineers, ~60% ICs / 40% EM/PM. We will share anonymized company metadata and opt-in contact data post-event.
- Sponsorship: recommending a single co-sponsor package for Redwood (covers workshop speaker, landing page build, joint content). I'll send a tailored MOU with exact deliverables and a DocuSign link.

Links & attachments: 
- Draft landing page / agenda: https://docs.google.com/document/d/retreat-outline
- HubSpot record (we've created a placeholder): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890
- MOU / signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD1234

I'll route the DocuSign this afternoon. Can you please confirm the primary speaker names and who will own the landing page by EOD Mon? If that works, we'll plan a 30-min sync (Aug 10, 10am PT) as Ben proposed.

Mira Singh
Head of Partnerships, ScoutOps
